required_concepts: square of a number ending in 4
acceptable_paraphrases: the square of 608 has a unit digit of 4
critical_errors: incorrectly stating that (608)² does not end in 4
misidentifying powers of 2 or 5 as incorrect
omitting any mention of prime factorization
misconceptions: stating (608)² ends with a digit other than 4
failing to recognize the role of prime factorization in determining divisibility
grading_notes: Points will be awarded for correctly identifying key concepts and their implications. Misunderstandings about number properties, especially regarding square endings and prime factors, should be noted.
